name: Mattazza
description: Mattazza is a traditional Italian trick-avoidance game, often described as a chaotic and humorous variant of the 'Loser Wins' family. Played with a 40-card Italian deck, the goal is specifically to NOT be the best or the worst player in terms of points captured. It is a game of social sabotage and precise point management, where being average is the key to survival.

content.text: Mattazza is a traditional Italian trick-avoidance game, often described as a chaotic and humorous variant of the 'Loser Wins' family. Played with a 40-card Italian deck, the goal is specifically to NOT be the best or the worst player in terms of points captured. It is a game of social sabotage and precise point management, where being average is the key to survival.
Part of the ancient Italian 'Rovescino' (Reverse) game group, which prizes losing tricks over winning them. It became popularized in Northern Italy as a parlor game.
40 cards. Ranking: 3, 2, Ace, King, Knight, Jack, 7, 6, 5, 4.
